flood_envelope.message:
⚠️ 响应中重复工具调用超限，已主动停止
Repeated tool calls exceeded the response limit; stopped locally
flood_envelope.hint:
同一响应包含过多同参数调用，未采纳该工具批次。可手动重试；若再次发生，可切换模型或供应商。这不表示服务宕机，重复来源请查看请求溯源。
The repeated tool batch was not adopted. Retry manually, or switch model/provider if it recurs. This does not indicate an outage; inspect request evidence for the repetition source.
